+"""SQLAlchemy ORM models defining the database schema."""
+
+from datetime import datetime, timezone
+from sqlalchemy import (
+    Column,
+    DateTime,
+    Float,
+    ForeignKey,
+    Integer,
+    JSON,
+    String,
+    Text,
+)
+from sqlalchemy.orm import declarative_base, relationship
+
+Base = declarative_base()
+
+
+class Document(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "documents"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    doc_type = Column(String, nullable=False)  # "sample_exam", "lecture_note", "slides"
+    raw_text_path = Column(String, nullable=True)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)
+
+    blueprints = relationship("ExamBlueprint", back_populates="source_document")
+    summaries = relationship("MaterialSummary", back_populates="document")
+
+
+class ExamBlueprint(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "exam_blueprints"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    source_doc_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=False)
+    blueprint_schema = Column(JSON, nullable=False)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)
+
+    source_document = relationship("Document", back_populates="blueprints")
+    generated_exams = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="blueprint")
+
+
+class MaterialSummary(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "material_summaries"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    document_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("documents.id"), nullable=False)
+    summary_text = Column(Text, nullable=False)
+    key_points = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
+    formulas = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)
+
+    document = relationship("Document", back_populates="summaries")
+
+
+class GeneratedExam(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "generated_exams"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    blueprint_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("exam_blueprints.id"), nullable=False)
+    title = Column(String, nullable=False)
+    created_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)
+
+    blueprint = relationship("ExamBlueprint", back_populates="generated_exams")
+    questions = relationship("Question", back_populates="exam", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+    attempts = relationship("ExamAttempt", back_populates="exam")
+
+
+class Question(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "questions"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    exam_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("generated_exams.id"), nullable=False)
+    topic_id = Column(String, nullable=False, index=True)
+    question_type = Column(String, nullable=False)  # "MULTIPLE_CHOICE", "SHORT_ANSWER"
+    prompt = Column(Text, nullable=False)
+    options = Column(JSON, nullable=True)
+    solution_rubric = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    max_points = Column(Float, nullable=False, default=1.0)
+
+    exam = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="questions")
+    responses = relationship("QuestionResponse", back_populates="question")
+
+
+class ExamAttempt(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "exam_attempts"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    exam_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("generated_exams.id"), nullable=False)
+    student_id = Column(String, nullable=False, index=True)
+    total_score = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+    submitted_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)
+
+    exam = relationship("GeneratedExam", back_populates="attempts")
+    responses = relationship("QuestionResponse", back_populates="attempt", cascade="all, delete-orphan")
+
+
+class QuestionResponse(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "question_responses"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    attempt_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("exam_attempts.id"), nullable=False)
+    question_id = Column(String, ForeignKey("questions.id"), nullable=False)
+    student_answer = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+    score_awarded = Column(Float, nullable=True)
+    feedback_text = Column(Text, nullable=True)
+
+    attempt = relationship("ExamAttempt", back_populates="responses")
+    question = relationship("Question", back_populates="responses")
+
+
+class StudentTopicMastery(Base):
+    __tablename__ = "student_topic_mastery"
+
+    id = Column(String, primary_key=True, index=True)
+    student_id = Column(String, nullable=False, index=True)
+    topic_id = Column(String, nullable=False, index=True)
+    attempts_count = Column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    correct_count = Column(Integer, default=0, nullable=False)
+    mastery_level = Column(Float, default=0.0, nullable=False)
+    last_evaluated_at = Column(DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc), nullable=False)

+"""Pydantic schemas establishing strict API contracts."""
+
+from typing import List, Optional
+from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
+
+
+class TaskResponse(BaseModel):
+    task_id: str
+    status: str
+
+
+class DocumentUploadResponse(BaseModel):
+    task_id: str
+    status: str
+    document_id: str
+
+
+class TaskStatusResponse(BaseModel):
+    task_id: str
+    status: str
+    progress_percentage: int
+    result_reference_id: Optional[str] = None
+    error_message: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+class BlueprintAnalyzeRequest(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+
+
+class TopicDefinition(BaseModel):
+    topic_id: str
+    name: str
+    weight_percentage: float
+
+
+class QuestionBreakdown(BaseModel):
+    topic_id: str
+    question_type: str
+    count: int
+    difficulty: str
+
+
+class BlueprintResponse(BaseModel):
+    blueprint_id: str
+    source_document_id: str
+    exam_title: str
+    estimated_time_minutes: int
+    topics: List[TopicDefinition]
+    question_breakdown: List[QuestionBreakdown]
+
+
+class ExamGenerateRequest(BaseModel):
+    blueprint_id: str
+    study_material_ids: List[str] = Field(default_factory=list)
+    mode: str = "STANDARD"
+
+
+class PracticeQuestionItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    topic_id: str
+    question_type: str
+    difficulty: str
+    prompt: str
+    options: Optional[List[str]] = None
+    max_points: float
+
+
+class PracticeExamResponse(BaseModel):
+    exam_id: str
+    blueprint_id: str
+    title: str
+    questions: List[PracticeQuestionItem]
+
+
+class StudentQuestionResponseItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    selected_option_index: Optional[int] = None
+    text_answer: Optional[str] = None
+
+
+class ExamSubmissionRequest(BaseModel):
+    exam_id: str
+    responses: List[StudentQuestionResponseItem]
+
+
+class QuestionEvaluationItem(BaseModel):
+    question_id: str
+    is_correct: bool
+    points_awarded: float
+    feedback: str
+
+
+class ExamEvaluationResponse(BaseModel):
+    attempt_id: str
+    exam_id: str
+    score_achieved: float
+    total_possible: float
+    evaluations: List[QuestionEvaluationItem]
+
+
+class MaterialSummaryResponse(BaseModel):
+    document_id: str
+    summary: str
+    key_points: List[str]
+    formulas: List[str]
+
+
+class TopicMasteryItem(BaseModel):
+    topic_id: str
+    topic_name: str
+    mastery_percentage: float
+    status: str
+
+
+class ReadinessResponse(BaseModel):
+    overall_readiness_score: float
+    topic_mastery: List[TopicMasteryItem]
+    recommended_focus_topic_id: Optional[str] = None

+"""FastAPI Application defining API routes and contract signatures."""
+
+from typing import Optional
+from fastapi import FastAPI, File, Form, Header, UploadFile, status
+from pilot.app.backend.schemas import (
+    BlueprintAnalyzeRequest,
+    BlueprintResponse,
+    DocumentUploadResponse,
+    ExamEvaluationResponse,
+    ExamGenerateRequest,
+    ExamSubmissionRequest,
+    MaterialSummaryResponse,
+    PracticeExamResponse,
+    ReadinessResponse,
+    TaskResponse,
+    TaskStatusResponse,
+)
+
+app = FastAPI(
+    title="AI-Powered Adaptive Exam Preparation API",
+    version="0.1.0",
+    description="API Gateway and service contracts for the exam preparation system.",
+)
+
+
+@app.post(
+    "/api/v1/documents/upload",
+    response_model=DocumentUploadResponse,
+    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
+    tags=["Document Ingestion"],
+)
+async def upload_document(
+    file: UploadFile = File(...),
+    document_type: str = Form(...),
+    x_session_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Session-ID"),
+):
+    """Accepts document upload and enqueues parsing task."""
+    return DocumentUploadResponse(
+        task_id="task_pending",
+        status="PROCESSING",
+        document_id="doc_pending",
+    )
+
+
+@app.get(
+    "/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}",
+    response_model=TaskStatusResponse,
+    tags=["Task Orchestration"],
+)
+async def get_task_status(task_id: str):
+    """Checks status of an asynchronous background task."""
+    return TaskStatusResponse(
+        task_id=task_id,
+        status="PENDING",
+        progress_percentage=0,
+    )
+
+
+@app.post(
+    "/api/v1/blueprints/analyze",
+    response_model=TaskResponse,
+    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
+    tags=["Blueprint & Analysis"],
+)
+async def analyze_blueprint(request: BlueprintAnalyzeRequest):
+    """Triggers structural analysis on ingested exam document."""
+    return TaskResponse(task_id="task_pending", status="PROCESSING")
+
+
+@app.get(
+    "/api/v1/blueprints/{blueprint_id}",
+    response_model=BlueprintResponse,
+    tags=["Blueprint & Analysis"],
+)
+async def get_blueprint(blueprint_id: str):
+    """Retrieves blueprint definition by ID."""
+    raise NotImplementedError("Contract defined; implementation in T4.")
+
+
+@app.post(
+    "/api/v1/exams/generate",
+    response_model=TaskResponse,
+    status_code=status.HTTP_202_ACCEPTED,
+    tags=["Practice Exam Generation"],
+)
+async def generate_exam(request: ExamGenerateRequest):
+    """Enqueues novel practice exam generation task."""
+    return TaskResponse(task_id="task_pending", status="PROCESSING")
+
+
+@app.get(
+    "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}",
+    response_model=PracticeExamResponse,
+    tags=["Practice Exam Generation"],
+)
+async def get_exam(exam_id: str):
+    """Fetches generated practice exam payload."""
+    raise NotImplementedError("Contract defined; implementation in T5.")
+
+
+@app.post(
+    "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}/submit",
+    response_model=ExamEvaluationResponse,
+    tags=["Evaluation & Feedback"],
+)
+async def submit_exam(exam_id: str, submission: ExamSubmissionRequest):
+    """Submits student exam responses for evaluation."""
+    raise NotImplementedError("Contract defined; implementation in T7.")
+
+
+@app.post(
+    "/api/v1/materials/{document_id}/summarize",
+    response_model=MaterialSummaryResponse,
+    tags=["Extended Study Materials"],
+)
+async def summarize_material(document_id: str):
+    """Generates summaries, formulas, and key points from study material."""
+    raise NotImplementedError("Contract defined; implementation in T10.")
+
+
+@app.get(
+    "/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness",

+async def get_readiness(
+    x_session_id: Optional[str] = Header(None, alias="X-Session-ID"),
+):
+    """Retrieves topic mastery and exam readiness indicators."""
+    raise NotImplementedError("Contract defined; implementation in T12.")

+"""Unit tests verifying backend data models, Pydantic schemas, and API contracts."""
+
+from pilot.app.backend.models import (
+    Base,
+    Document,
+    ExamBlueprint,
+    MaterialSummary,
+    GeneratedExam,
+    Question,
+    ExamAttempt,
+    QuestionResponse,
+    StudentTopicMastery,
+)
+from pilot.app.backend.schemas import (
+    DocumentUploadResponse,
+    TaskStatusResponse,
+    BlueprintResponse,
+    PracticeExamResponse,
+    ExamSubmissionRequest,
+    ExamEvaluationResponse,
+    MaterialSummaryResponse,
+    ReadinessResponse,
+)
+from pilot.app.backend.app import app
+
+
+def test_database_model_tables_registered():
+    expected_tables = {
+        "documents",
+        "exam_blueprints",
+        "material_summaries",
+        "generated_exams",
+        "questions",
+        "exam_attempts",
+        "question_responses",
+        "student_topic_mastery",
+    }
+    actual_tables = set(Base.metadata.tables.keys())
+    assert expected_tables.issubset(actual_tables)
+
+
+def test_pydantic_schema_serialization():
+    doc_resp = DocumentUploadResponse(
+        task_id="task_doc_89a7fbc2",
+        status="PROCESSING",
+        document_id="doc_550e8400",
+    )
+    assert doc_resp.task_id == "task_doc_89a7fbc2"
+
+    task_resp = TaskStatusResponse(
+        task_id="task_doc_89a7fbc2",
+        status="SUCCESS",
+        progress_percentage=100,
+        result_reference_id="doc_550e8400",
+        error_message=None,
+    )
+    assert task_resp.status == "SUCCESS"
+
+    bp_resp = BlueprintResponse(
+        blueprint_id="bp_4a11b6c8",
+        source_document_id="doc_550e8400",
+        exam_title="Intro to OS",
+        estimated_time_minutes=60,
+        topics=[
+            {"topic_id": "t1", "name": "Sync", "weight_percentage": 40.0},
+            {"topic_id": "t2", "name": "Memory", "weight_percentage": 60.0},
+        ],
+        question_breakdown=[
+            {"topic_id": "t1", "question_type": "MULTIPLE_CHOICE", "count": 2, "difficulty": "INTERMEDIATE"},
+        ],
+    )
+    assert len(bp_resp.topics) == 2
+
+    practice_exam = PracticeExamResponse(
+        exam_id="exam_7c9e6679",
+        blueprint_id="bp_4a11b6c8",
+        title="Practice Exam",
+        questions=[
+            {
+                "question_id": "q_001",
+                "topic_id": "t1",
+                "question_type": "MULTIPLE_CHOICE",
+                "difficulty": "INTERMEDIATE",
+                "prompt": "Sample prompt",
+                "options": ["A", "B"],
+                "max_points": 5.0,
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+    assert practice_exam.questions[0].max_points == 5.0
+
+    eval_resp = ExamEvaluationResponse(
+        attempt_id="att_88b12e34",
+        exam_id="exam_7c9e6679",
+        score_achieved=14.0,
+        total_possible=15.0,
+        evaluations=[
+            {
+                "question_id": "q_001",
+                "is_correct": True,
+                "points_awarded": 5.0,
+                "feedback": "Correct",
+            }
+        ],
+    )
+    assert eval_resp.score_achieved == 14.0
+
+
+def test_openapi_schema_contains_all_api_contracts():
+    openapi = app.openapi()
+    paths = openapi.get("paths", {})
+    assert "/api/v1/documents/upload" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/tasks/{task_id}" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/blueprints/analyze" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/blueprints/{blueprint_id}" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/generate" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/exams/{exam_id}/submit" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/materials/{document_id}/summarize" in paths
+    assert "/api/v1/diagnostics/readiness" in paths
